angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 786,141 km at 273.84 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.6517 +/- 0.0173 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12): 273.84 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.13 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Smith 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of XO-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015AcA....65..117S/abstract): 786,141 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.04 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Smith 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of XO-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015AcA....65..117S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5430 +/- 70 K from Smith 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015AcA....65..117S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Smith 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of XO-5 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015AcA....65..117S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/xo-5.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.349, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-5 (pscomppars): spectral type G8 V, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-5 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.05 dex, from Smith 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015AcA....65..117S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-5 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.06, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-5 (pscomppars): age 8.5 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of XO-5 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.8 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
